description: Source code for the 'git tag' builtin command, implementing tag listing, creation, deletion, verification, and signing functionalities within Git.

methods.name: list_tags
methods.description: Lists tags based on provided filters, sorting, and format.

methods.name: for_each_tag_name
methods.description: Iterates over specified tag names, applying a callback function.

methods.name: collect_tags
methods.description: Collects tag references into a list for deletion or processing.

methods.name: delete_tags
methods.description: Deletes specified tags from the repository.

methods.name: verify_tag
methods.description: Verifies the authenticity of a tag using GPG.

methods.name: do_sign
methods.description: Signs a tag object buffer with GPG.

methods.name: write_tag_body
methods.description: Writes the body of a tag object to a file descriptor.

methods.name: build_tag_object
methods.description: Creates a new tag object in the object database.

methods.name: create_tag
methods.description: Creates a new tag, possibly with an editor, message, and signatures.

methods.name: create_reflog_msg
methods.description: Generates a reflog message for a new tag.

methods.name: cmd_tag
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git tag' command with subcommands and options.
